title: Firstborn of Arugal
wikitext: {{Npcbox | name = Firstborn of Arugal | image = Firstborn of Arugal.png | level = 55 | faction = Combat | aggro = [[Alliance|Alliance]] [[Horde|Horde]] | race = Worgen | creature = Humanoid | type = Rare Elite | status = Killable | location = [[Gilneas]] }} The '''Firstborn of Arugal''' is a rare worgen that can be found wandering the northern farms of [[Gilneas]] near the [[Greymane Wall]]. ==Loot== * [[Old Hunter's Boots]] * [[Explorer's Shoulders]] * [[Arugal Family Sigil]] ==Notes== * In comparison to the worgen mobs that occupy northern Gilneas, the Firstborn of Arugal is significantly higher-leveled than them and may catch players unaware during questing. ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.17.0|note=Added.}} [[Category:Worgen characters]] [[Category:Gilneas mobs]] [[Category:Skinnable mobs]] [[Category:Rare elite mobs]]
